1.title: Real NASA SPHEREx snapshots
1.body: Each frame combines infrared exposures taken on different dates, aligned onto the exact same sky grid.

2.title: Press Play to blink
2.body: Use Play/Pause or arrow keys to flip between dates. Stationary stars stay still; nearby worlds shift.

3.title: Something jumping? Try Diff mode
3.body: Diff subtracts the average sky. Moving objects stand out as a bright-and-dark pair.

4.title: Spotted something interesting?
4.body: Click "I found something!" to save coordinates and share your candidate with the community.
